entries.b2209e4d219edf66: It positions the medium-term management plan "Denyo2026", which starts in fiscal 2024, as the first three-year plan toward achieving its long-term vision for fiscal 2035. In Japan, it states that it will secure stable earnings by maintaining and raising its top share in portable generators and welders, and aims to expand its share of emergency generators. Overseas, in addition to deepening and developing the North American market, it states that it will enhance and strengthen dealer and service networks in Asia, the Middle East and others, and will explore entry into untapped markets such as the Global South. Looking ahead to a decarbonized society, it states that it will also invest in research and development of new products, starting with hydrogen-fueled generators.
